title: Chapter 32 Pursuit
content:
Chapter 32 Pursuit

"Is an unknown realm so powerful?"

The man from the Uranus Galaxy frowned.

Isn't it just an unknown realm? Even if he is very strong, so what? He is making himself invincible.

Yunqi didn't say anything.

And this also made the Uranus Galaxy forces more unscrupulous.

"Well, let's show you the strength of our Uranus Galaxy."

The next moment, two more unknown realm masters stepped out of the tower.

This time, there were five unknown realm masters in the Uranus Galaxy.

"They are still holding back!"

The surrounding forces exclaimed.

Is this a real first-level galaxy?

It is indeed so terrifying!

However, this scene still did not cause any fear in the eyes of the masters of Huangcheng.

Huang Shou, who was holding a sword in the corner, was so sleepy that tears were about to come out.

At this time, Huang Shou's eyes suddenly lit up, and then he looked into the depths of the starry sky.

The next moment, Huang Shou disappeared on the spot.

"Hahaha, one of your people has run away, are you sure you don't want to surrender?"

The people of the Uranus Galaxy mocked.

Watching the disappearance of the Wilderness Guard, Yunqi frowned slightly. The Wilderness Guard was the most terrifying existence besides the Lord of the City. It was impossible for him to escape. There must be something wrong.

"If you want to fight, then fight. If you want to enter the Wilderness City, then step over my body!"

Yunqi said with a firm look.

And this also made the strong men of the Wilderness City full of fighting spirit.

Looking at the unyielding appearance of the strong men of the Wilderness City, the people of the Uranus Galaxy looked ugly.

They just wanted to seize the treasure in the most relaxed state.

Because next, they will definitely be blocked by the other first-level star systems.

They are not very sure. If they encounter a first-level star system that is stronger than themselves, then they will be finished.

"Okay, okay, very good."

"In that case, then I will fulfill your wish!"

"Kill them!"

This time, the Uranus Galaxy forces did not say much and rushed directly towards the strong men of the Wilderness City.

Suddenly, countless explosions sounded again from the starry sky.

.........

The other side of the universe.

Eternal Galaxy.

A middle-aged man suddenly appeared in the Eternal Temple.

"How dare you break into the Eternal Temple! Don't you want to live?"

The next moment, an old man in a Taoist robe full of ancient atmosphere appeared in front of the middle-aged man.

If Lu Daosheng was here, he would definitely recognize this old man.

It was the old man who guarded the gate when he first came to the Eternal Galaxy.

Because of that incident, the old man resigned from his post guarding the Eternal Border and returned to the temple to guard the temple.

At this time, the middle-aged man looked at the old man.

"You, don't you recognize me?"

Hearing this, the old man was puzzled.

Who do you think you are? Do I need to know you?

But the old man didn't say it, but thought about it seriously.

This thought really made him remember, and he was immediately shocked.

Looking at the appearance of the middle-aged man in front of him, the old man was shocked.

"Palace, Palace, Palace,,,"

"Palace Master!"

For a moment, the old man stuttered.

He would never have thought that the middle-aged man in front of him was the previous Palace Master of the Temple.

He really deserves to die!

He actually insulted the previous Palace Master of the Temple.

Thinking back then, when this person in front of him was conquering the world, he was still wearing open-crotch pants.

"Palace Master, I deserve to die!"

The old man knelt down directly, his expression was uglier than eating shit.

However, Duan Heng just waved his hand and asked in confusion: "Why is the Temple so deserted now? Where are they? Where is Ouyang Yanqing?"

When he came back, there were so many fewer people in the Eternal Temple.

And even Ouyang Yanqing, who he came back to find, was missing.

This made him puzzled.

Could it be that Ouyang Yanqing had received the news and led people to the edge of the universe.

Thinking of this, Duan Heng immediately showed a look of relief.

As expected of the successor that Laozi has designated.

Looking at Duan Heng's expression, the old man was puzzled, and then hesitantly said: "Palace Master, the Lord God has left the Eternal Galaxy for some time, probably for hundreds of years. As for where she went, I only know that it is a place called Tianxuan World."

"As for the strong men in the palace, they all went to the Xuan Gu Galaxy. It is said that there is the breath of heaven-defying treasures there. Not only my Eternal Galaxy, but many galaxies have gone there."

Hearing this, Duan Heng was stunned in place.

Xuan Gu Galaxy?

Many galaxies have gone there. . .

So, it is not like what Old Yang said, that they all went to support their universe border, but to seize treasures.

In an instant, Duan Heng sorted out these things, and his face became extremely ugly.

A terrifying breath continued to overflow from Duan Heng's body.

The whole hall began to tremble constantly.

"Palace Master, calm down, Palace Master, calm down!"

The old man looked at Duan Heng and shouted in horror.

Hearing this, Duan Heng calmed down a bit and then put away his breath.

Looking at the somewhat empty Eternal Temple, Duan Heng shook his head in disappointment and left directly.

The direction he was heading to was the Xuan Gu Galaxy.

Now, the universe has reached a critical moment of life and death, and those galaxy forces are still thinking about fighting among themselves to seize treasures.

He wants to stop all this.

As for Ouyang Yanqing, he can only wait for a while, and only hope that the boundary of the universe can hold out for a while longer.

.........

At the border of Xuan Gu Galaxy.

A huge group of interstellar fleets broke through time and space, and headed towards Tian Xuan World.

On the flag, the two words "eternal" were particularly conspicuous.

The terrifying aura that continued to overflow from it made countless creatures around them tremble with fear.

At this moment, a man holding a sword appeared in front of the fleet and blocked their way.

Seeing the words on the flag, Huang Shou frowned slightly.

"Are you from the Eternal Galaxy?"

"Since you know the name of my Eternal Galaxy, how dare you block our way?"

Hearing this, Huang Shou frowned even deeper.

If he hadn't accidentally heard that Ouyang Yanqing was from the Eternal Galaxy, he would have smashed the fleet with a sword.

At the same time, in the deserted city of Tian Xuan World.

Ouyang Yanqing, who was in the Tower of Babel, suddenly opened his eyes.

Feeling the familiar breath, Ouyang Yanqing's expression changed slightly.

"Not good."

Ouyang Yanqing then quickly withdrew from the Tower of Babel.

But the next moment.

Bang!

Ouyang Yanqing directly bumped into a strong chest.

Just as he was about to get angry, Ouyang Yanqing looked up and saw the familiar face.

"Lu, Brother Lu."

Immediately, Ouyang Yanqing quickly took two steps back.

And Lu Daosheng looked at Ouyang Yanqing with a half-smile.

"Miss Ouyang, what do you plan to do about this?"

Hearing this, Ouyang Yanqing naturally knew what Lu Daosheng was asking.

"I'll deal with it right away."

Ouyang Yanqing then soared into the sky, and the next moment, a gap appeared above the Tianxuan World. Ouyang Yanqing immediately left the Tianxuan World and headed towards the depths of the starry sky.

At this time, in the deserted city, Lu Daosheng suddenly narrowed his eyes and looked straight at the galaxy barrier.

"Interesting."

At this time, above the starry sky of the Tianxuan World.

The battle was getting more and more intense.

Not only did the extra-system forces suffer heavy casualties, but so did the strong men in the Wasteland City.

Gu Chen and Yun Qi, who were strengthened by the power of the world, were fighting against seven unknown realm strong men.

The fighting aura was so strong that countless vacuum auras had formed around them, and the void turbulence continued to pour in.

At this time, the strong men in the Wasteland City had become different.

They were becoming more and more united.

At the same time, their sense of belonging to the Wasteland City was getting stronger and stronger.

They were not only fighting for themselves, but also for the Wasteland City.

And this was the reason why Lu Daosheng did not take action from the beginning.

What his men must understand is that this is not only his Wasteland City, but everyone's Wasteland City.

He did not want them to rely on their own strength.

Unless there were special circumstances, or the Wasteland City was at the moment of life and death, he would not take action.

"Hahaha, so satisfying!"

Yun Qi looked ferocious, and his killing intent was constantly rampant.

In front of him, there was already a sea of blood.

"You monster."

The face of an unknown realm expert who led the Uranus Galaxy was extremely ugly.

This was the only word he could think of to describe the man in front of him.

If they continued to fight, they might win, but they would definitely pay a heavy price.

"Retreat!"

Then, the Uranus Galaxy took the lead in retreating.

The other forces saw this and immediately left in a hurry.

"Keep killing, don't let them run away!"

"Yes!"

The entire Lu family army shouted immediately.

At this moment, the more than 300,000 Lu family soldiers seemed to have only 80,000 left, which shows how tragic this battle was.

And after endless years, these 80,000 people will also become the elite of the elite Lu family army that will shock the heavens and the worlds.

"Kill!"

The remaining 80,000 Lu family soldiers were in high spirits and followed Yunqi to chase and kill.

Gu Chen did not hesitate and followed him.

The other experts followed him when they saw this.

"Master, they are chasing us!"

"What! These lunatics!!"

At this moment, a terrifying wave of power suddenly surged from the border of the galaxy.

In an instant, not only these extragalactic forces, but also the people in the deserted city who came to pursue them were thrown to the ground, and many weak practitioners fainted directly.

"What, what is this?"

At this moment, countless strong men stopped and looked ahead with fear in their eyes.

I saw that a huge black hole had appeared in front of them.

That was because the starry sky collapsed due to the excessive power.

Swish!

In the depths of the starry sky, a sword sound resounded through the world.
